newsitem.title: ITALY: IBCA affirms Banco Desio credit rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Banco Desio credit rating.

text.p: European credit rating agency IBCA said it had affirmed its credit ratings for Italy's Banco di Desio e della Brianza as short-term A2 and long term A-Minus.
Its individual rating was affirmed at B/C and the legal rating at five.

IBCA said in a statement the bank commmanded one of the highest interest margins in Italian banking and in order to deal with competition had increased the number of financial products on offer, allowing it to achieve higher commission income in 1996.
But it said the bank's cost base, which was already high, had been placed under further pressure following branch openings, the merger of a leasing subsidiary and the renewal of staff contracts.
"BD's liquidity is good. The bank is amply capitalised with an end-1996 total EU capital ratio of 17.84 percent," IBCA said.
